designNotes: Claude Opus 5.5 (runtime-confirmed claude-opus-5-5) full-song design for every Chronomia section outside the human reference window [25000,45000) ms of full-mix-v2 analysis 8a57032b3a6f7755f84e. The parent splices the user's Refined chart (180 notes, 14 holds) into that window unchanged, including its four human-authored moments without a v2 event (27753, 31189, 39053, 40242 ms); none of them is represented here. Last AI start before the window: FG0270 at 24978 ms; first after: FG0500 at 45066 ms. The design follows the user's stated reference intent - steady eighth-note flow where measured attacks exist, two-hand chords (one lane per hand) on important evidenced accents, holds where a sustained layer is measured - and keeps intentional rests, measured stops and the recurring 0-6-12 accent figure instead of filling the grid. Sections: bars 0-2 near-silent rest; 3-10 quarter-pulse intro; 11-18 build; 19-20 stop-time break; 21-23 bass-beat/upper-offbeat interlock into the reference; 42-46 accent stabs; 47-52 drive; 53-59 syncopated call/response; 60-66 break; 67-90 second main section; 91-100 stop and bridge; 101-108 second build; 109-121 climax; 122-124 pre-final break with the song's strongest hit; 125-132 final section; 134 final hit, 135 last upper attack; the decay and the invalid-energy tail are left empty. Other-stem attacks are labelled upper-stem estimates, never melody; bass/drum-only selections are labelled rhythm-section support. Chords are authorial accents, not pitch claims; hold endpoints are time references, not certified releases. No audio was listened to; timing (227 BPM, offset 0), grid and acceleration settings are untouched. Phrase evidence, hold grades and open review choices are in RATIONALE.md.
